The public Mod-system entry point is `src/shell/src/mod-system/index.ts`.

The following symbols are exported or implemented by that entry point:

- `ModLoader`
- `runFrontendBoot`
- `Mod`
- `BlockEvent`
- `registrationId`
- `ModelReference`
- `ObjectReference`
- `WorkspaceReference`
- `SlotReference`

- `createBlockAdapter`
